muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /counter datastar(sse(Mixed(ctx, send, marshalJSON(sendSignals))))" -}}<li>{{ .Result }}</li>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Sig struct {
	Count int `json:"count"`
}

// Server patches the DOM and updates client signals in one response: a
// counter increments an element and pushes the new count into the signal
// store, in method-call order.
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Mixed(_ context.Context, send func(string) error, sendSignals func(Sig) error) {
	_ = send("x")
	_ = sendSignals(Sig{Count: 1})
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/counter", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	elements := strings.Index(body, "event: datastar-patch-elements\ndata: elements <li>x</li>\n\n")
	signals := strings.Index(body, "event: datastar-patch-signals\ndata: signals {\"count\":1}\n\n")
	if elements < 0 {
		t.Fatalf("body = %q, want a patch-elements frame", body)
	}
	if signals < 0 {
		t.Fatalf("body = %q, want a patch-signals frame", body)
	}
	if !(elements < signals) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q: frames must appear in method-call order (elements before signals)", body)
	}
}
